name: ChaosChat
short: Fatboy blurts unhinged R-rated nonsense, absurd replies, and Slavic-language outbursts.
description: Adult-oriented offline surreal chat comedy: original profanity-laced one-liners, deranged questions, playful context-specific answers, optional one-turn follow-ups, randomized Russian/Polish/Ukrainian/Czech/Serbian interjections with adjustable probability, and channel/cooldown controls. No external API or message logs.
author: Will
North
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-server configuration and aggregate reply counts only. User IDs for anti-spam cooldowns and short follow-ups exist in memory and are cleared on cog unload. Message content and user IDs are never persistently saved or sent to third-party services.
install_msg: Load with [p]load chaoschat, enable with [p]chaoschat on, and set [p]chaoschat mode feral. Configure Slavic outbursts with [p]chaoschat slavic 25 and [p]chaoschat language random. Adult humour/profanity; only enable it in channels where that is welcome. Message Content Intent is required.
